notes.title: OpenXR Runtime Update
notes.content: A popup now appears when your OpenXR runtime is not set to Meta/Oculus. This is to ensure passthrough properly appears, which is only compatible with the Meta OpenXR runtime.

notes.title: Major UI overhaul and update
notes.content:
I made it so that the recipe display is more like a book, where you flip from page to page, rather than view everything in one large scroll view. The UI was changed to better fit in with the Meta Quest as well as Steam's design language, and was made to be blacker and more readable.

The engine was also updated to Unity 6. Let me know what you think of the design changes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wUlf1Jx.jpeg[/img]
